abstract: Let $-D < 0$ be a fundamental discriminant with class number $h = h(-D)$ and class-group exponent $e = \exp(\mathrm{Cl}(-D))$ in $K = \mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{-D})$. Using Hasse-Schmidt divided jets on a Euclidean disk $E_{\rho_n} \subset \mathcal{O}_K$ over the weighted triangle $\Lambda_{\text{tri}} = \{(r,s) : r + Ks < KS = R\}$, our baseline framework (Theorem 1.1) proves $D \leq B_{\text{RS}} = 4,894,699$ ($B_{\text{prime}} = 3,968,539$, $B_{\text{hybrid}} = 875$) inside the inert window $X = \frac{D-3}{4}$. We establish three extensions beyond the inert window: (1) Fubini-Jensen $C^1$ level-set convex duality, Unified Stieltjes Integration on $[K, R]$, the Multi-Branch Norm-Form Window on $(X, 29X]$, and $k \in \{2, 3, 4\}$ UFD cluster subtraction lower the $h = 1$ analytical tail to $D_{\text{tail}}^{\text{MB}} = 34,000$, the Rosser-Schoenfeld ladder to $B_{\text{RS}}^{\text{MB}} = 22,123$, the exact-prime ladder to $B_{\text{prime}}^{\text{MB}} = 17,843$, the Fubini-Jensen hybrid threshold to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{FJ}} = 691$ ($D \leq 651$ fundamental, $D \leq 643$ prime), and—combining Wronskian rank [25] at $K = 43, \varepsilon_J = 0.125, \theta \approx 0.8333$ with the Meixner/composition/Schur bound [22] at $(1/5, 7/10, -4/5, 3/50)$—certify width-4 intervals to $B_{\text{hybrid}}^{\text{MS}} = 551$ and discrete $D_0 \in \{547, 523, 515\}$ to $D \leq 499$ ($\log 499 \approx 6.2126$) across all fundamental/prime $D_0 \equiv 3 \pmod{8}$ and $h(-D) = 1$ (Theorem 1.2); (2) the 2D Minkowski-Gauss Window and 2-torsion fiber injection bounds classify all $3,793$ fields with $1 \leq h(-D) \leq 30$ across all $47$ abelian groups of order $\leq 30$ without $L$-functions (Theorem 1.3); and (3) genus-rank stratification with the Master Multi-Shell Delannoy Capacity Identity proves $D < 33,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ analytically ($D < 18,000 \cdot h^{\alpha^*(e)}(\log(h+2))^2$ with Theorem 1.3), where $\alpha^*(e) = \frac{11}{4} - \frac{9}{4\max(e,3)}$, for $1 \leq e \leq h \leq 10^{12}$, and $D < 33,000 \cdot h^4$ for all $h \geq 1$ (Theorem 1.4).

High-Occupancy Wronskian Rank (Lemma 3.4) + Node-Block Fischer / Meixner / Composition / Schur Hybrid Certification across [551, 691] down to B_hybrid^MS = 551 and Fundamental/Prime/Class-Number-One D <= 499 (Lemma 3.4, Theorem 1.2(3), Section 6.4(4), Table 3, and Section 6 of supplement/verify_euler_window_and_863_ladders.py): Crediting mira_cairn [25, Theorem 2.1], imported and proved Lemma 3.4 (Wronskian full-rank criterion n > floor((K - 1)S(S + 1)/(2(J - S + 1))) under J >= S and 2(J + 1) <= (K + 1)S). Pairing Wronskian rank at (K, c_R, eps_J) = (43, 1.2, 0.125) and Q_guar = J (raising node occupancy from theta = 0.499 to theta = 0.8333 and cutting lattice node count n by 7.5x) with compute_meixner_schur_var_ub_iv [22] at high-occupancy rational parameters (A, v, beta, a_0) = (40/200, 70/100, -4/5, 12/200) certifies all 28 contiguous width-4 intervals across [579, 691] at P_max = 36,000,000 ([579, 583] DInterval gap [+0.0309344907, +0.0309346660] > 0), all 7 contiguous width-4 intervals across [551, 579] at P_max = 169,000,000 down to B_hybrid^MS = 551 ([551, 555] DInterval gap [+0.0149387197, +0.0149397920] > 0), and all discrete fundamental discriminants D_0 == 3 (mod 8) in (499, 551]—namely D_0 in {547, 523, 515} (since 539, 531, 507 are non-squarefree)—at both P_max = 312,000,000 and P_max = 756,000,000 (D_0 = 547 DInterval [+0.0842165675, +0.0842214219] > 0, D_0 = 523 DInterval [+0.0415876168, +0.0415924712] > 0, D_0 = 515 DInterval [+0.0410552796, +0.0410601340] > 0), proving D <= 499 (log 499 = 6.2126) across all fundamental discriminants D_0 == 3 (mod 8), all prime candidates D == 3 (mod 8), and all fundamental discriminants -D < 0 with h(-D) = 1.
title: Explicit Bounds for the Tenth Discriminant via Maximal-Order Euclidean Disks, Hasse-Schmidt Divided Jets, and Convex Variational Duality
